lines.beaver: 내일 친구 결혼식에 가요. 뭘 입을까요?
lines.beaver_en: I'm going to a friend's wedding tomorrow. What should I wear?
lines.beaver_roman: Naeil chingu gyeolhonsige gayo. Mwol ibeulkkayo?
lines.learner: 이 파란 원피스를 입어도 돼요. 어때요?
lines.en: You could wear this blue dress. How about it?
lines.roman: I paran wonpiseureul ibeodo dwaeyo. Eottaeyo?

lines.beaver: 예뻐요. 그런데 좀 추울 것 같아요.
lines.beaver_en: It's pretty. But I think it might be a bit cold.
lines.beaver_roman: Yeppeoyo. Geureonde jom chuul geot gatayo.
lines.en: Then you can wear a sweater over it.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Can I wear a necklace?
lines.en: Yes, you can wear a necklace and earrings.

lines.beaver_en: I want to wear a scarf too.
lines.en: Good. You can take the scarf off inside.

lines.beaver: 제 동생도 같이 가요. 동생은 뭘 입어요?
lines.beaver_en: My brother is coming too. What should he wear?
lines.beaver_roman: Je dongsaengdo gachi gayo. Dongsaengeun mwol ibeoyo?
lines.en: A suit and a white dress shirt would be good.

lines.beaver: 동생은 양복이 없어요. 운동복은 안 돼요?
lines.beaver_en: He doesn't have a suit. Can't he wear sportswear?
lines.beaver_roman: Dongsaengeun yangbogi eopseoyo. Undongbogeun an dwaeyo?
lines.learner: 운동복은 안 돼요. 제 양복을 입어도 돼요.
lines.en: Not sportswear. He can wear my suit.
lines.roman: Undongbogeun an dwaeyo. Je yangbogeul ibeodo dwaeyo.

lines.beaver: 고마워요. 반바지는요? 결혼식 후에 바다에 가요.
lines.beaver_en: Thanks. What about shorts? We're going to the beach after.
lines.beaver_roman: Gomawoyo. Banbajineunyo? Gyeolhonsik hue badae gayo.
lines.en: You can wear shorts at the beach.

lines.beaver_en: Then where do we change clothes?
lines.en: You can change in the restaurant restroom.

lines.beaver_en: Should I bring a swimsuit too?
lines.learner: 네, 수영복은 이 가방에 넣어도 돼요.
lines.en: Yes, you can put the swimsuit in this bag.
lines.roman: Ne, suyeongbogeun i gabange neoeodo dwaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. Now I've picked all my clothes!
lines.en: Great. Have a nice time at the wedding!
